about: Specifications with a closed requirement list each, and the edits an owner makes to a specification between two drafts. The list is the owner's reading, fixed here so that no model is in the measurement: revision_identity.py applies each edit to the prose and to the list by rule, so what each requirement of the first revision became in the second is known by construction, not judged. An edit's `truth` is derived, never written: a requirement whose quote is untouched is `same`, one whose words the edit rewrote is `changed`, one whose sentence the edit removed is `gone`.

cases.prose: The vending controller starts idle with no credit. Inserting a coin adds its value to the credit; 100 and 500 coins are accepted and any other coin is returned at once. A product button selects a product. When the credit is at least the selected product's price, the product is dispensed and the change is returned; otherwise the price is shown. Pressing cancel returns the whole credit and the controller goes back to idle. If credit is held and nothing happens for 30 seconds, the credit is returned. While dispensing, buttons are ignored. When the dispense-done sensor reports, the controller is idle again. If the selected product is out of stock it is not dispensed and a sold-out message is shown.

cases.prose: The door controller keeps the door in one of four conditions: closed, opening, open and closing. An open request while the door is closed starts opening it. When the fully-open sensor reports, the door is open. If the door has been open for 20 seconds without a new open request, it starts closing. An open request while closing reverses it to opening. When the fully-closed sensor reports, the door is closed.

cases.prose: The connection keeper starts disconnected and immediately tries to connect. If the attempt succeeds it is connected; if it fails it waits 5 seconds and tries again, indefinitely. While connected, a link-lost notification returns it to waiting 5 seconds before the next attempt. A shutdown request in any condition stops it for good.
